description: Read one participant's own wish list, using their private token (the /s/ link). Does not return who they give a gift to, their Secret Santa's wishes, or anyone else's list. The organizer token cannot read wish lists.

language.description: Language of the reply and the share messages: en, es, ca, de, pt, fr, it, nl, pl, da, no, sv, ru, ko, ja. Defaults from region.

participant_token.description: That person's private token or /s/ URL.

name: get_wishlist
title: Read a wish list
